newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends up after crop report.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends up after crop report.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS
Jan (3rd pos) 1,164 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,170 *
Open/hi/low 1,160/1,168/1,150 Prev close 1,172.50
Prev settlement 1,157 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended higher after choppy session. Buyers returned after release of October crop report from private forecaster Ivan Wong, which seen as neutral. Players also covered positions after Wednesday's selling.
PALM OIL PHYSICALS - Also moved uncertainly. Trading remained thin with focus again on crude palm oil and selected refined products.
Traders said that though prices could hold in the short term, the longer term outlook was not encouraging as exports in November and December were expected to be lower.
"This could build up stocks," a trader said.
Palm oil stocks at end-September stood at 894,030 tonnes, official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority figures showed.

Third position January crude palm oil futures ended up seven ringgit at 1,164 ringgit ($461.90) a tonne after trading between 1,150 and 1,168. Traders pegged immediate resistance for the contract at 1,180 with support seen at 1,150.
Volume on the futures market was 2,242 lots against 1,463 lots on Wednesday.
Physicals prices moved uncertainly within narrow ranges, with activity focusing on crude palm oil and selected products.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,170 ringgit ($464.29) a tonne with bids at 1,167.50, after trading between 1,167.50 and 1,175.
Nov (central) was offered at 1,160 with bids at 1,155, and traded from 1,152.50 to 1,160. Nov (north) saw offers at 1,155 and bids at 1,145.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,185 ringgit with bids at 1,172.50. It was traded between 1,170 and 1,180.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,175 and bids at 1,165.
Among refined products, Nov RBD palm olein was offered at $537.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Dec and Jan/Feb/Mar at $532.50. Nov was traded at $530 and $535.
Nov RBD palm oil was offered at $502.50 and Dec at $500. Nov was traded from $497.50 to $502.
Nov RBD palm stearin saw sellers at $370 and Dec at $372.50.
Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate was offered at $305.
